text:
morgan: FYI - noticed intermittent failures in staging when private tenants get routed to hosted: the probe context (x-infer-probe) is missing and hosted treats it as public -> fallback model. Repro included.

anita: that's the sidecarless handoff path, right? could be the proxy strip or controlplane passthrough.

morgan: exactly. snapshot of request before handoff: 
```
POST /v1/chat
Host: infer.local
x-tenant-id: t-77
x-infer-probe: lease=lkj234;mode=probe
```
After hitting hosted: header gone.

pablo: we need a robust, principled abstraction for asserting probe provenance across hosting modes. Brainstorm options: per-request signed assertion, mTLS peer cert, opaque token sync, or header re-injection with explicit consent.

cecil: tradeoffs: header is lowest effort but forgeable; signed assertion needs key exchange but works for air-gapped; mTLS is elegant when TLS egress is allowed; opaque sync requires periodic federation.

anita: propose a tiered contract in onboarding manifest: probe_assertion_mode: [mtls|signed|opaque|header_opt_in]. Hosted defaults to deny if missing.

morgan: implementation notes:
- signed: sidecar emits a compact signed blob (lease, issued_at, ttl) signed by tenant key (thumbprint exchanged at onboarding). Hosted verifies and caches per-lease.
- mtls: tenant presents short-lived client cert during egress handoff; hosted maps cert SAN to lease.
- opaque: private controlplane pushes tokens to hosted verifier if federation allowed; hosted validates against cache.
- header_opt_in: only enabled by tenant flag; must be audited and rate-limited.

pablo: perf: verify once per lease and cache. For signed blobs, use JWS with kid=tenant-id. For mTLS rely on TLS session reuse.

cecil: security: ensure we don't accept unverified headers. Default must be fail-closed. Provide opt-in for fail-open. Also log all probe-derived promotions.

anita: UX: console should show current probe mode, last verified lease, and a way to upload pubkeys/cert bundles for air-gapped onboarding.

morgan: dev plan:
- add manifest field and validation (anita, 2d)
- prototype signed-assertion format and cache (pablo, 3d)
- small proxy change to preserve header for header_opt_in tenants only (morgan, 1d)
- security review on key handling and federation endpoints (cecil, 3d)

security-bot: ci: probe-handshake-matrix queued -> job/handshake-probe/v2 :white_check_mark:

pablo: tiny open question: for signed assertions, do we allow tenant-supplied public keys only, or hosted-issued subordinate keys? both might be useful.

cecil: offer both: customer-provided key for compliance, hosted-issued short-lived key for convenience. Document risks.

anita: last note: make manifest backward-compatible; if manifest omits probe_assertion_mode, treat as strict deny.

morgan: thanks all — I'll file the RFC follow-up and link tests. We can review prototype Thursday. :rocket:
